content.title: 表语从句(Predicative Clauses)速查
content.intro: 结构:主语 + 系动词(be / seem / look / sound / remain) + 表语从句。判断口诀:从句完整不缺成分→that;缺主语/宾语→what/who;表疑问(何处/何因/如何)→where/why/how;表'是否'→whether;说原因→because;'好像'→as if / as though。

rows: 从句完整、不充当成分:The truth is that he was right.
从句缺主语或宾语:That is what matters. / 充当主宾
从句问地点/原因/方式:The question is how we can solve it.
表'是否'(不用 if):The problem is whether we have time.
说原因 because;'好像' as if:It looks as if it will rain.

specialRules.rule: that 在从句中不充当任何成分,从句结构完整
specialRules.mark: The fact is that cholera still exists.(完整→that)

specialRules.rule: what 充当主语或宾语;缺成分才用 what,不可用 that
specialRules.mark: Science is what you can do.(do 缺宾语→what)

specialRules.rule: 表'是否'用 whether,if 不引导表语从句
look / seem / sound + as if / as though 表'好像'
specialRules.mark: It seemed as if all the theories were useful.

why: 表语从句放在系动词后,补充说明主语的内容。先看从句是否缺主语/宾语:缺→用 what/who;不缺再看句意:陈述事实→that,问地点/原因/方式→where/why/how,问是否→whether,说原因→because,表'好像'→as if。
gaokaoPoints: that 与 what 的区分(看从句是否缺成分);whether 与 if(表语从句只用 whether)是语法填空与改错高频点。
the reason is that ...(不再用 why);the question/problem is how/whether ... 为固定高频搭配。

examVsReal.exam: The truth is that he was right.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: The truth is, he was right.
examVsReal.note: 考试书面语保留 that;口语中常省略 that 或用逗号停顿

examVsReal.exam: It looks as if it will rain.(考试)
examVsReal.real: It looks like it's gonna rain.
examVsReal.note: 考试用 as if + 从句;口语里常用 like 代替 as if
